svg.title: More languages. A different kind of complexity.
svg.desc: Six-language comparison. Separate directed pairwise models require thirty models: twenty existing and ten added for Korean. One shared multilingual model expands to include Korean, illustrated with twelve directed connections to a common hub. Connection counts are audited.

g.text: More languages. A different kind of complexity.
One dedicated model per translation direction.
Illustrative comparison: one model per directed pair. Counts are not compute costs or quality guarantees.
